descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains recordings of different physics experiments:
 - Motion: bouncing ball, pendulum, sliding block,
 - Intensity: LED,
 - Scale: dropped ball

The parameters.json file contains an estimation of the physical parameters relevant to the differential equations.

All videos are shot at 60 FPS and in 1920x1080 resolution. For the LED experiment, auto-exposure, autofocus, and white balancing are disabled.
